description: Built 31-10-2026 from VATSIM Los Angeles ARTCC (ZLA)'s 'Los Angeles Tower SOP' v5.95 (19-03-2026), section 1-3 'Runway Use Program' -- the full 22-page document was read directly. Mode ids are runway-coded, extended to join multiple runways per role without a separator. A lower-priority 'load-balancing' note in the source ('during heavy arrival traffic, consider sending aircraft south of 07R/25L to 07L/25R') is deliberately NOT a fourth mode: it has no wind/time criterion and no distinct runway pairing, so it doesn't fit the mode-selection model -- see research doc. No per-mode maxCrosswindKt/capacity: unresearched, falls back to settings.json. The engine's own tailwind check (tailwindDryKt=10kt) triggers the West-to-East switch, not a time band -- see operating_plan.json.

modes.description: West Traffic (preferred/default): arrivals 24R and 25L, departures 24L and 25R (ZLA SOP 1-3). '25L may be used for aircraft parked south of runway 25L.'

East Traffic: arrivals 06L and 07R, departures 06R and 07L (ZLA SOP 1-3). Used when the tailwind component on West Traffic exceeds 10 kt (ZLA SOP 1-3); this pack relies on the engine's own tailwind check against settings.json tailwindDryKt (10 kt) to enforce that trigger, not a time band. '07R may be used for aircraft parked south of runway 07R.'

Over-Ocean Traffic: arrivals 06R, departures 25R (ZLA SOP 1-3). 'Noise abatement configuration between 0000L and 0630L' -- a scheduled overnight default, confirmed to carry NO wind criterion anywhere in the source document (full-text search for 'crosswind' returned zero hits). See operating_plan.json for the time band.
